title: Quality Loop Repair — Code Failure Logger + Crystallisation + Brief Fix
description: Closes three quality/process gaps found in audit: (1) swarm code rejections are never written to failure-library — structured failure data is lost, (2) manually-written code (FP-007 bypass) never goes through crystalliseSkill() — skill bank frozen at Sprint 095, (3) generate-sprint-brief.py reads stale progress.md for sprint number — autonomous Claude gets wrong 'next sprint' context (saw Sprint 104 when actual was 192). All 4 tasks are FP-007 safe.

tasks.title: Code failure logger module — scripts/lib/code-failure-logger.ts
tasks.description: Create scripts/lib/code-failure-logger.ts. New file, <80 lines. Export one function: logCodeFailure({ taskId, sprintId, agentId, attemptNum, score, model, rejectionReason, issues, failType }). failType enum: 'destructive_rewrite' | 'truncation' | 'qa_gate' | 'supervisor_rejected' | 'no_files'. Writes JSON to data/failure-library/code/fail-{8-char-uuid}.json. Creates directory if missing. Silently catches all errors (never throws — must not break the swarm). JSON shape: { entry_id, task_id, sprint_id, agent_id, attempt_num, score, model, fail_type, rejection_reason, issues: [{severity,file,description}], filed_at }. Use only stdlib: crypto (randomUUID), fs, path.

tasks.title: Add manual-write crystallisation step to autonomous-prompt.txt
tasks.description:
Modify autonomous-prompt.txt. Find the section 'STEP 5 — FIX IF NEEDED'. After that section and before 'STEP 6 — SHIP', insert a new block:

STEP 5B — CRYSTALLISE IF YOU WROTE CODE DIRECTLY (mandatory when swarm was bypassed):
  If in Step 3 or Step 5 you wrote code directly (swarm failed/killed/FP-007):
  Run this inline Node.js to crystallise the skill (replaces the swarm's auto-crystallise):
    node -e "const {crystalliseSkill}=require('./scripts/lib/skill-crystalliser'); crystalliseSkill({agentId:'coder', taskId:'TASK_ID', sprintId:'sprint-NNN', taskTitle:'TITLE', taskType:'feature', model:'manual-sonnet', taskTarget:'manual', score:80, approachSummary:'Written directly — swarm bypassed (FP-007)', keyPatterns:['manual write'], antiPatterns:['FP-007 file too large for swarm']});"
  Replace TASK_ID, sprint-NNN, TITLE with actual values.
  Also add to progress.md under the sprint entry: '- Swarm bypassed: yes (FP-007). Manual crystallise: done.'
  If crystalliseSkill call fails (module resolution error), skip and note in progress.md — do not block shipping.

This section should be ~20 lines, inserted as plain text between STEP 5 and STEP 6.

tasks.title: Fix generate-sprint-brief.py — derive last sprint number from git log, not progress.md
tasks.description: Modify scripts/generate-sprint-brief.py. The brief currently reads progress.md for sprint history. progress.md was last updated at Sprint 103 — so every generated brief says 'next sprint: 104' even when Sprint 191 is done. Fix: add a get_last_sprint_from_git() function that runs: subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', '-20'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=str(project_root)) and parses output lines matching r'Sprint (\d+):' to find the highest sprint number. Use this number as 'LAST sprint number completed' in the brief, overriding whatever progress.md says. Insert this function near the top of generate_brief() before the Ollama call. Also update the 'NEXT sprint number needed' line: next = last_git_sprint + 1. If git call fails, fall back to progress.md (existing behavior). Keep changes to <40 lines added.
tasks.context: Sprint 193. Root cause of stale brief: progress.md hasn't been updated since Sprint 103.
